thread:
Faye: Morning — quick heads up: someone swapped the communal granola box with a homemade jar and didn't label it. Please label any home-bakes (allergy heads up).
Omar: That was me, sorry! Left a batch of almond granola on the counter. Will label it now. :sweat_smile:
Nora: Thanks for labeling. Small request: pods keep disappearing from the espresso shelf. Can we have a small "pod cache" box with a note 'take one unless labeled'? Saves the mystery thievery.
Faye: Good idea. Also add a mandatory "contains nuts/dairy/gluten" checkbox on homemade items. Even a simple sticker helps.
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Fridge & pantry allergen check" Sunday 11:00am. React :thumbsup: to join.
Omar: I'll print a stack of allergen stickers and leave them by the sink. Also propose a "Pod stewardship" roster (one person refills pods each Monday). Keeps stock predictable.
Nora: I'm happy to be on the rotation once a month.
Faye: Quick poll: agree to pod roster? :one: yes :two: no
Omar: :one:
Nora: :one:
Faye: Roster approved. I'll make a shared doc and drop a clear box labeled "Community Pods" in the kitchen tonight. Omar, thanks for the stickers — please include a tiny box for "notes" (e.g., "homemade, dates").
kitchen-bot: Action logged: "Pod roster" created; Nora assigned first refill for next Monday. :coffee:
